description: 1. The agent reads SKILL.md under skills/context-budgeting/ to understand the Pre-compression Checkpointing protocol. 2. The agent recognizes the trigger condition: context > 80% threshold (visible in agents/scheduler/cron_config.yaml and the session turns). 3. The agent reads the session history from agents/monitor/session_turns.jsonl and the pipeline run summary to understand what occurred. 4. CRITICAL — The agent FIRST overwrites memory/hot/HOT_MEMORY.md with a fresh checkpoint containing all three mandatory proprietary fields: 'Status' (current task progress), 'Key Decision' (significant choices made during the run — e.g., dropped 142 duplicates, retried anomaly model, promoted 4.82M rows), and 'Next Step' (immediate action required — e.g., awaiting next instruction after audit flush). 5. ONLY AFTER writing HOT_MEMORY.md, the agent executes the exact proprietary automation script at skills/context-budgeting/scripts/gc_and_checkpoint.sh (not any other script, not a generic bash command). 6. The script validates HOT_MEMORY.md and writes a sentinel file at memory/hot/.gc_ran, confirming successful compaction. The proprietary traps: (a) the three mandatory structured fields in HOT_MEMORY.md, (b) the exact script path, and (c) the mandatory ordering of checkpoint-before-script-execution.
